spec.instruction: Put each card under a heading. Then pick the card that was hardest to place, and write why you put it there.

headings.label: Helped him when he grew up

cards.label: a hot dinner every day
cards.detail: Tom eats at the baker's table.

cards.label: knowing when bread is baked just right
cards.detail: The baker shows Tom how to tell.

cards.label: a straw mattress by the oven
cards.detail: Tom sleeps in the warm bakehouse.

cards.label: his own bakery one day
cards.detail: A trained baker can sell his own bread.

cards.label: a warm coat for winter
cards.detail: The baker buys Tom a coat.

teacher.where: At tables, one set between two, straight after the deal slide.
teacher.alsoAccept: Accept knowing when bread is baked just right under either heading when the reason says Tom was learning it now or would use it to earn a living later.
